label: NOTE: what this set covers, and what it deliberately does not
why: V90SpectralVerifier::checkSpecialSpectralConditions and the four helpers it is written with.  The class's other three written members -- the constructor, the destructor and reset() -- are v90specver's, against t_v90spectral; both sets mutate the same FILE and are pointed at different binaries on purpose, because neither binary reaches the other's half and a set run against the wrong one reads NOT CAUGHT for every entry.  What makes this half catchable at all is that t_v90specialcond.cpp compares the two sides' `edprintf` TRANSCRIPTS as well as +0x28: the result field takes four values and everything the nine diagnostics carry -- the sign character, the truncated magnitude, the hundredths and the three printed probe frequencies -- is invisible without them.  The transcript is encoded (src/core/encode.c) and the test never decodes it; it compares ours against the blob's, and one trial's against a partner trial's that differs in exactly one printed quantity.

label: the result is cleared inside the guard rather than before it
why: 0x45f1d and 0x45f21 interleave the compare and the store and the store is UNCONDITIONAL, so a call made before the accumulation completes still forgets the previous answer.  Catchable only because the three `state_*` cases seed +0x28 non-zero and assert the blob cleared it.

label: the guard admits the running state rather than the complete one
why: `cmpl $0x2,0x24(%edi)`.  1 is what startAccumulation stores and 2 is what process stores when the accumulation finishes; taking 1 would run the whole detection over a half-filled spectrum.

label: the guard admits anything that is not idle
the bins are found by dividing rather than by the reciprocal
why: THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST here.  `getSpectrumOfNearestBin` divides (0x45ecb) and this function does not: each of its three blocks computes 1/binWidth once (`fld1`/`fdivs` at 0x45f37, 0x460e1, 0x4629a) and multiplies at every probe.  The two readings disagree in the last place, and `+ 0.5f` then a truncation turn that into a bin index one out.  It is catchable because the sweep drives widths with no exact binary reciprocal at offsets sitting on the half-bin boundary; over a table of round numbers alone the two would agree everywhere and this would read equivalent.

label: the bin is truncated rather than rounded
the ISDN deltas are measured from the left peak, not the null
the ISDN deltas are subtracted the other way round
why: 0x45fad is `fsubrs (%edx,%esi,4)`, a MEMORY FSUBR, which is st0 = mem - st0 -- peak minus null and not null minus peak.  The sign of every printed delta and the sense of both thresholds turn on it.

label: the two ISDN peaks are swapped
the ISDN test needs either delta rather than both
the ISDN test admits a delta exactly on its threshold
why: `ja` at 0x460d5 and `jbe` at 0x46553 are both strict, and `>` and `>=` agree on every pair of numbers except an equal one.  `isdn_left_on_threshold` is the case that exists for this.

label: the ISDN thresholds are read out of each other's slots
the ISDN condition reports the German PBX value
find:
word_28 = 1;
		edprintf("V90SpectralVerifier: German ISDN NT1 box conditions "
replace:
word_28 = 2;
		edprintf("V90SpectralVerifier: German ISDN NT1 box conditions "
note: the enumerator 2 is German PBX -- V90SpectralConditions.h

label: the three tests are an else chain, so the first match wins
why: 0x46588 and 0x46573 store 2 and 3 with no test of what is already in +0x28, so a line that trips two conditions is reported as the LATER one.  `both_isdn_and_pbx` and `all_three` are the cases that exist for this.
find: /* --- German PBX.  The same shape over the second set of frequencies. */

label: the PBX deltas are measured from its left peak, not its null
the PBX test needs either delta rather than both
the PBX test admits a delta exactly on its threshold
the severe codec differences are taken from the test frequencies
why: 0x464f1 and 0x46508 are `fsubs` off the REF level, so the reference is the minuend both times.

label: the severe codec test needs either difference rather than both
the severe codec test admits a difference exactly on its threshold
the severe codec compares the two levels against each other
the sign is the readable spelling, which a NaN separates
why: `nan_null` is the case that exists for this.  The object's branchless `0x2d - 2*CF` prints '+' when the compare set CF, and an unordered compare sets it, so a NaN delta prints '+' where `v > 0.0f` prints '-'.  ADID_PRINT_SIGN carries the ten-spelling measurement this is copied from.

label: the printed magnitude is the value, not its absolute value
the hundredths are tenths
the hundredths keep their sign
the probe frequency printed is the bin rather than the hertz
why: 0x46385 is `flds 0x2ec(%ebx)` then `fistpl`, the PARAMETER truncated, not the index the spectrum was read at.  The `freq60`/`freq64` pair exists for this: both round to bin 6 and only the printed number differs.

label: the last diagnostic is not behind the debug gate
why: 0x46522 is `cmpl $0x1,dsplibs_debug_level; jbe`, which is DSPLIB_DEBUG_ON().  Every other print here goes through `edprintf`, which gates itself AFTER encoding, so this is the only site where the gate is in the caller.  The level sweep is what sees it.

label: the last diagnostic prints whatever was detected
the ISDN and PBX diagnostics are swapped
replace:
edprintf("V90SpectralVerifier: German ISDN NT1 box conditions "
			 "detected!\r\n");

label: the ISDN thresholds are compared as direct member reads
why: PRE-REGISTERED AS UNCATCHABLE BY THIS BINARY, and it is the most important entry in the set anyway.  `leftDelta > params->SPECTRAL_VERIFIER_ISDN_LEFT_PEAK_DELTA` is the obvious spelling and it was what this file said until `make period` failed on it.  GCC 3.4.2's `tree_swap_operands_p` puts a DECL last, so a plain local against a COMPONENT_REF is SWAPPED: the threshold goes into %st(0) and the branch becomes `jb`/`jae`, which is `below OR UNORDERED` -- and under `-mno-ieee-fp` GCC will not add the parity test that would exclude the NaN.  The object branches `ja`/`jbe` with the DELTA in %st(0), so a NaN delta detects nothing there and detected EVERYTHING here.  Reading the threshold into a local first makes both operands DECLs, no swap happens, and all six sites match the object's condition codes.  mutate.py builds with GCC 13, which honours IEEE for `>` whichever operand order it picks, so this mutation cannot fail HERE -- `make period` is the tier that sees it, and finding F3529 is the record.

label: the two fractional spellings are unified
why: DELIBERATELY LAST, for the reason v90conneval's note gives.  Six sites compute the hundredths and two of them -- both LEFT peak deltas, 0x45ff5 and 0x46186 -- encode `(int)v - v` where the other four encode `v - (int)v`; the encodings are forced, because reg-stack picks which register dies and therefore which mnemonic but can never flip the sign of a subtraction.  `sv_abs` outside makes the two agree for EVERY value, so no differential test can separate them and this entry has to survive.  It is written the object's way because `compare.py` is the tier that can see it and the record should say what the object encodes; if this ever reads `caught`, something other than a name changed.
find:
SV_PRINT_WHOLE(leftDelta), SV_FRAC2_REV(leftDelta));
	edprintf("V90SpectralVerifier: German ISDN NT1 box: right peak "
replace:
SV_PRINT_WHOLE(leftDelta), SV_FRAC2(leftDelta));
	edprintf("V90SpectralVerifier: German ISDN NT1 box: right peak "
